correctness.rationale: Every H^{odot k} element is additively generated by degree-k products 3^a4^b5^c. Because 25=9+16, iteratively eliminate pairs of 5 factors, leaving exactly Xi=3^(k-i)4^i (0<=i<=k) and Yi=5*3^(k-i)4^(i-1) (1<=i<=k). They strictly interleave Xi<Yi<Xi+1 by 1<5/4<4/3. All earlier elements than Xi are divisible by 3^(k-i+1), but Xi is not. For Yi, the sole earlier non-divisible Xi can appear at most once (Yi<2Xi); Yi-Xi still has lower 3-valuation than all other earlier candidates. Hence no generator is redundant, yielding 2k+1 for all k. Independent degree-k raw monomial additive dynamic programming verified k<=8; finite checks are not a universal proof.
